opportunity.title: Pentagon Facility Janitorial and Custodial Services
opportunity.agency: Department of Defense — Washington Headquarters Services
opportunity.description: The Washington Headquarters Services requires janitorial and custodial services for approximately 12,000 square feet of administrative office space in the Pentagon Reservation. Services include: daily trash removal, vacuuming, mopping hard floors, restroom cleaning and restocking (soap, paper towels, toilet paper), periodic deep cleaning of common areas, and window cleaning (interior surfaces only). Personnel must be able to pass a DoD security background investigation for unescorted access. Performance period: base year plus two option years. Equipment and supplies furnished by the contractor. Work hours: 6:00 AM to 9:00 AM weekdays.
